english.title: Place false description of letter box / post office
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without the authority of the universal service provider concerned,

(A)_[placed]_
(B)_[maintained]_

(C)_[in]_
(D)_[on]_

(E)_[a house, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(F)_[a wall, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(G)_[a door, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(H)_[a window, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(I)_[a box, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(J)_[a post, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(K)_[a pillar, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_
(L)_[a place, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)]_

belonging to you or under your control

(M)_[the words "letter box" accompanied with words, letters or marks which signified or implied, or may reasonably have led the public to believe, that it was a universal postal service letter box]_
(N)_[words, letters or marks, namely **(..SPECIFY CHARACTERS..), which signified or implied, or may reasonably have led the public to believe that that place was a universal postal service post office]_
(O)_[words, letters or marks, namely **(..SPECIFY CHARACTERS..), which signified or implied, or may reasonably have led the public to believe that that receptacle was a universal postal service letter box]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 87(1) and (5) of the Postal Services Act 2000.
